body:
m1 - REQUESTING GOLDEN RE-CUT AUTHORIZATION for the blend candidate. Everything else is green; the golden is the last thing and I am not regenerating it without your word, per the precedent you set this morning.

STATE: alignJVM 200/200, codecJVM 107/107 after I carried supportWeight through the wire record and both codec directions. Only WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenResourceSuite fails.

WHY IT MUST MOVE, and I verified the mechanism rather than assuming: CostBreakdownWire gained a supportWeight field, so the encoded hsmm/v1 JSON gains a key per cell. The artifact is a content address over the encoding, so a fingerprint that did NOT move would mean the wire record is not addressing its own content - the same argument you made for the importance re-cut.

CURRENT ARTIFACT, measured not remembered:
  checksum 44a76b728b8dfc7474536cc17aed9f7a2718116f672711c2c0cb773c989b9ba9
  bytes    25,294
  and the ExpectedChecksum literal at WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenSuite agrees with the resource's
  own shasum, so the starting point is coherent.

YOUR FOUR CONDITIONS FROM THIS MORNING, which I will meet unless you amend them:
  1. post old and new checksum AND byte length side by side
  2. re-run the sentence and title canaries and say so explicitly
  3. keep root's JVM/JS-versus-Native split exactly as built - re-deriving bytes, not redesigning
  4. state in the commit WHY it moved

ONE DIFFERENCE FROM THE IMPORTANCE RE-CUT WORTH YOUR ATTENTION. That one moved the fingerprint because a VALUE changed. This one moves it because the SCHEMA changed - a new key per cost cell. So the diff will be large and structural rather than a few digits, and "inspectable" means something weaker here: nobody can eyeball 25KB of added keys. What I CAN offer instead is that the added key is derivable - supportWeight is a pure function of the terms present and the eligible set - so an independent re-derivation is a real check rather than a formality.

If you would rather this landed as two candidates - the cost model first without the wire field, then the wire and golden separately - say so. It would keep the golden move isolated from the behaviour change, which is the argument for it; against it, the cost model alone would compute a supportWeight that nothing records, which is the thing the bead exists to fix.

Not regenerating until you answer.
